pan.tooltip: Stereo balance after Mono is summed in. 0 = unchanged (Mono to both). −1 = left only. +1 = right only.

seed.tooltip: Chaos noise seed. Same Seed = same output; new modules get their own.

upShape.tooltip: Rising glide curve. Lin = constant rate. Log = fast start, eases in. Exp = slow start, finishes quickly. Smooth = slow start and end.

downShape.tooltip: Falling glide curve. Lin = constant rate. Log = fast start, eases in. Exp = slow start, finishes quickly. Smooth = slow start and end.

upTime.tooltip: Seconds to climb full scale (+1). 0 = unlimited rise rate.

downTime.tooltip: Seconds to fall full scale (−1). 0 = unlimited fall rate.

bias.tooltip: Offset added before slew (0…1). Hidden by default — show it to step the target by hand.

inLow.tooltip: Input value that maps to Out Low. Default −1 (bipolar). Slider domain −10…+10.

inHigh.tooltip: Input value that maps to Out High. Default +1 (bipolar). Slider domain −10…+10.

outLow.tooltip: Output at In Low. Default 0. Slider domain −10…+10.

outHigh.tooltip: Output at In High. Default +1. Slider domain −10…+10.
